First, convert 49 weeks and 3 days to days:  
49 weeks × 7 days/week = 343 days  
343 + 3 = 346 days earlier.

1660 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian calendar, but note: 1600 was a leap year, so 1660 is leap).  
Start date: 1660-06-17.  
June has 30 days, so 17 days into June.  
Go back 346 days:

From 1660-06-17 back 17 days → 1660-05-31.  
From 1660-05-31 back further:  
May has 31 days, so back 31 more days → 1660-04-30.  
Total days subtracted so far: 17 + 31 = 48 days.  
Remaining: 346 − 48 = 298 days earlier from 1660-04-30.

Now go month by month backward into 1659:  
April 30 → March 31: 30 days (March has 31, so 30 days back to April 1? Let's do systematically):
